newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Home market underpins Foster's profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Home market underpins Foster's profit.

text.p: The Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's local Australian market powered the aspiring international brewer to a better-than-expected annual net profit for 1995/96, despite the sale of its British brewing unit, Courage.

Foster's two percent rise in net profit to A$293.3 million for the year to June 30 exceeded the average market forecast for a pre-abnormal net profit of around A$270 million, and confirmed the group's local brewer as its growth engine.
Carlton and United Breweries' earnings before interest and tax leapt 16 percent to A$327 million on increased market share and growth from its pubs and leisure business.
